UPDATE session_orchestration_task
SET status = 'Creating',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = ?
WHERE id = ?
  AND status = 'Planned'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM session_orchestration
      WHERE session_orchestration.id = session_orchestration_task.session_orchestration_id
        AND session_orchestration.status = 'Running'
  )
